text: The Federal Oil brand is the trademark of PT Federal Karyatama, an Indonesian lubricant manufacturer that ExxonMobil acquired in 2018.
short: Federal Oil is the trademark of PT Federal Karyatama, acquired by ExxonMobil in 2018.

source.name: ExxonMobil - ExxonMobil Indonesia: Our operations
source.quote: ExxonMobil acquired PT Federal Karyatama (FKT) in 2018. PT FKT is a lubricant manufacturer with Federal Oil™ as its trademark
